notes:
A clean page. Bullet 1 is the usual zone-in precondition after the previous quest, not a step, so it folds into step 1's note. The four '(Optional)' sub-bullets under bullet 2 ARE the page's own optional actions -- the same shape as the 'Optional:' clue NPCs in As Thick as Thieves -- so they are kept as four optional steps sharing a group rather than being thrown away as commentary; they give hints and nothing else, and none of them is observable. The page gives grids for Yoran-Oran (E-5) and Shantotto (K-7) but no zone; both grids continue Koru-Moru's Windurst Walls (E-7) and v1's own index already places yoran-oran and shantotto in zone 239, so Windurst Walls is used. Bonchacha and Maan-Pokuun are given with NO location at all, so their zone stays null rather than being guessed -- both names are unique, so a null zone matches wherever they really stand instead of matching wrongly.

The quiz is the interesting judgement. The page names no door: it says 'the Acolyte Hostel (K-6)' and 'interact with each of the six doors on the ground floor'. Six unmarkable, unobservable door clicks in a fixed building are one rung, not six, so bullet 4 is a single examine on the building name the page does give. Bullet 5 is a SECOND Acolyte Hostel building at (K-5), so it is its own step -- different grid, different action -- and it is the one that grants the key item in bullet 6. Bullet 6 is an outcome, not a step, and the Vile Elixir in it is a REWARD (it is in the header Reward list too), so it is not evidence; the Thesis on alchemy is. The self-inflicted trap in bullet 6's sub-sub-bullet -- already owning a Vile Elixir blocks completion -- is recorded on that step because it is the kind of thing that strands a player.

Windurst Waters North is not a zone; it is the north half of Windurst Waters (238). Bullets 7, 8 and 9 are three consecutive Koru-Moru steps and therefore one marker, but they are kept apart because only bullet 8 carries the trade requirement and only bullet 9 carries the day-aroo wait. The Quest Reqs field (Cold Bone, Warm Egg) is bullet 8's trade, not a separate gate. The Quiz de Vana'diel table is an answer key, not a walkthrough.

ADVERSARIAL PASS (stage D). One demotion, nothing removed. Steps 7 and 8 carry the SAME target name, 'Acolyte Hostel', at two different grids (K-6 and K-5), and the page never names the door you actually click on either of them -- a name-keyed marker cannot tell the two buildings apart, which is the same shape of defect as Operation Teatime's ??? at two grids. Step 7 was already medium for that reason; step 8 is demoted to match. Everything else survived the attacks: the Thesis on alchemy is granted by bullet 6, which is the outcome of bullet 5's cutscene and so belongs to that step and not to the Koru-Moru steps after it; it is not in the header Reward (the Vile Elixir is, and is correctly excluded); no item is evidence on two steps; n is dense 1..11; there is no empty AND-list; the order is the page's order; every step's target is the entity actually interacted with; and every name -- Koru-Moru, Bonchacha, Maan-Pokuun, Yoran-Oran, Shantotto, Fuepepe, Thesis on alchemy, Cold Bone, Warm Egg, Windurst Walls, Windurst Waters -- appears in the page text and resolves.

notes:
The Mythic Weapon unlock, and the worst-organised page in this batch: a 2024 'Alternative Battlefields' section has been pasted in ABOVE the quest it belongs to, so bullets 1 to 16 are its requirements, entry rules, party rules and exit conditions and the actual quest does not begin until bullet 17. Of those first sixteen bullets exactly none is a step: 1-4 are eligibility, 5-7 name where the three alternative battlefields are, 8-12 are party and time-limit rules, 13-16 are the four ways the arena spits you out. A verb scan would have produced sixteen.

The real ladder is bullet 17 (zone in), 18 (Abquhbah), 19 (trade the weapon), then the eight Notorious Monsters, then the unnumbered closing line that sends you back to Naja Salaheem. Salaheem's Sentinels is NOT a zone -- res/zones.lua has no such entry and v1's own index already carries 'salaheem's sentinels' as a clickable giver in zone 50 -- so the office is modelled as an object inside Aht Urhgan Whitegate and every NPC step in the quest sits in Whitegate, which is also what the header says.

The eight titles are explicitly 'in any order', so they are one group of eight and all draw at once. Zones: the four Salvage chariots have their Remnants named in the page, and the three beastman leaders are given ONLY their alternative-battlefield zones (Jade Sepulcher, Navukgo Execution Chamber, Talacca Cove) -- the page never names their bases, so that is the location recorded and the other route is flagged rather than invented. Odin gets no zone at all: the page says only 'See Einherjar'. Examining the three battlefield entrances is folded into each leader's fight, since only one of the three doors is even named ('Rock Slab' in Talacca Cove) and three unmarkable rungs in front of three fights are noise.

Nothing here is observable. The titles are the real progress and no packet this addon reads reports a title, so every step's evidence is null -- the Runic key and the Captain Wildcat badge are PREREQUISITES held before the quest starts, not things obtained at a step, and gates has no slot for a key item so they are flagged. The Vigil Weapon cannot be listed at all: it is whichever one of the Nyzul Isle set matches the Mythic you intend to build, the page names none of them, and 'Vigil Weapon' resolves as neither item nor key item -- so the trade carries only the Runic key and items_partial. The header leaves Repeatable empty but the page's own 'Repeating the Quest' section describes doing it again for each further Mythic, so repeatable is true on the page's authority; that section is not steps.

notes:
A scavenger hunt across six zones, and the densest evidence chain in this batch: eleven of the twelve gathered key items resolve, so nearly every collection step is independently observable. Bullet 1 is the zone-in precondition, bullet 4 is a heading for the list that follows and neither is a step. Bullets 5 to 14 are the hunt itself; nothing orders them, so they are one group and all draw at once -- with ONE exception recorded in the notes on both steps: the Cryptic memorandum in Foret de Hennetiel cannot be picked up until you have the Piece of a SCT Coalition report from the Western Adoulin fountain AND have taken it to Wegellion. Wegellion is a sub-bullet of bullet 10 but he is a real, required action and not commentary, so he is a step inside the same group.

Where the page names no entity, none is invented. The Celennia Memorial Library pair is filed under '(History)' and '(Geography)' with no NPC or object named, so that step has a zone and no target. The five ??? points are recorded as ??? -- unmarkable, but each one keeps its rung and its key items. 'Fontis Xanira' is read as the fountain's own name, which is what the page's parenthesis says it is. The Rala Waterways puzzle spot is written 'a blank spot', which is already in the normaliser's object deny list, so it keeps a rung and carries no marker.

The curio branch under bullet 15 is optional and ordered inside itself: Nhili Uvolep appraises the Copy of 'Hallowed Wood' into a replica (consuming it, and refusing to act before you have spoken to Palomel), while Polished Pebble turns the mystifying metal rod into a rusty katana which Palomel then turns into the Traditional Adoulinian katana. Both products are answered 'No' in bullet 16's own key, so neither is needed -- they are kept as optional steps because they are real, observable key items a player will otherwise wonder about. Note also that Palomel is described at the Western Adoulin fountain in bullet 10 and in Eastern Adoulin in bullet 15; bullet 15 is the one giving the instruction, so Eastern Adoulin is used.

The hand-in carries the five key items bullet 16 answers 'Yes' -- Wrath of the Land, Report of a sorcerous nation, The Verdancy, Giant sheep export record, Dictum on colonization -- because those are exactly what a perfect report needs and all five come from non-optional steps. Bullet 17's second visit to Roskin is a separate step for the one-game-day-plus-zoning wait, which nothing observable reports. The '== Optional ==' heading is inside the walkthrough, not an after-section: its bullets keep counting at 18. Bullet 20 is lore about the next quest.

ADVERSARIAL PASS (stage D). Three demotions, nothing removed. The page contradicts itself about where Palomel stands: bullet 10 puts her at the Western Adoulin fountain, bullet 15 across from the Scouts' Coalition entrance in Eastern Adoulin. The draft recorded both and used the bullet giving the instruction, which is the right choice, but the house rule for a self-contradicting page is to demote as well -- so both Palomel steps (14 and 17) drop to medium and the quest drops to medium with them. The rest held under attack: every evidence key item is granted at the step it hangs on and not earlier or later; none of them is a header Reward (the rewards here are XP and bayld only); no key item is evidence twice -- the Hallowed Wood copy, the SCT report piece, the mystifying metal rod, the rusty katana and the Rala memo each appear once as evidence and thereafter only as held items; the gathering order is the page's own list order; the '== Optional ==' section and the two curio conversions are the only conditional work and are all marked optional; bullet 15's top-level 'return to Palomel' is a numbered instruction and stays non-optional; every step has exactly one zone, with Wegellion's read from bullets 5 and 15 rather than guessed and Polished Pebble's left null because the page does not say which half of Adoulin the Inventor's Coalition is in; n is dense 1..20; there is no empty AND-list. All names probed -- 6 zones, 9 NPCs, 2 items and 16 key items -- resolve, so the draft's remark above that only eleven of the key items resolve understates it.
